name: Happy Path - Standard Sales Order Route
trigger: SOAP POST to /Glovia_SalesOrder with valid Salesforce outbound notification for SalesOrder creation
expected_outcome: Message routed via SequenceFlow_82 to Test_Mapping, custom headers logged via Interface_Generic_Headers, successfully completed at EndEvent_2 with HTTP 200/202
validates: Message router SequenceFlow_82 matching condition {{Glovia_Route_SalesOrder}}, property InputPayload initialization, and successful execution of message mapping and generic headers step.

name: Happy Path - Sales Order Return Route
trigger: SOAP POST to /Glovia_SalesOrder with notification satisfying ReturnSalesOrder condition
expected_outcome: Message routed via SequenceFlow_113 to CallActivity_71 (Interface_Generic_Headers) and terminates successfully at EndEvent_9
validates: Router SequenceFlow_113 matching {{Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder}}, bypass of Message Mapping 102, invocation of generic headers logging, and end at EndEvent_9.

name: Negative Path - Routing Condition Not Met (Escalation End)
trigger: SOAP POST with order code not matching SalesOrder or SO Return criteria (default branch)
expected_outcome: Execution branches to SequenceFlow_110 (Default) and triggers EndEvent_11 with EscalationCode RoutingConditionNotMet
validates: Default routing branch SequenceFlow_110 handling and EscalationEndEvent raising 'RoutingConditionNotMet'.

name: Exception Path - Malformed XML Payload Triggers Exception Subprocess
trigger: SOAP POST with corrupted/unparseable XML payload causing processing failure
expected_outcome: SubProcess_91 invoked by ErrorStartEvent 92, CallActivity_97 enriches body from property InputPayload, CallActivity_100 logs payload via Log_Payload.gsh, and terminates with EndEvent_95 (SOAP Fault)
validates: SubProcess_91 exception catching, property InputPayload restoration in CallActivity_97, execution of script Log_Payload.gsh, and proper SOAP 1.1 Fault generation.

name: Boundary / Edge Case - Maximum Allowed Body Size
trigger: SOAP POST with payload nearing the 40MB maximumBodySize limit defined on SOAP Sender Channel
expected_outcome: Adapter accepts payload under 40MB without memory exhaustion; property InputPayload successfully captured
validates: SOAP Sender adapter limit enforcement (maximumBodySize=40) and memory stability.
